mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.code,r.name,r.version,r.status,r.description,r.external_id,r.source_version,r.revision,r.published_at FROM routing r JOIN routing_product p ON p.routing_id=r.id JOIN material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.id=#{productId} AND m.material_type='PRODUCT' AND m.status='ENABLED' AND r.status='PUBLISHED' AND (r.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%') OR r.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search},'%')) ORDER BY r.code,r.version DESC,r.id LIMIT 100
